Overview

Cape Coast is a city in Central with a population of 200,000. A historic coastal city, home to the UNESCO-listed Cape Coast Castle, a powerful symbol of the transatlantic slave trade. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 275 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 22.0.
